scripts.test:unit: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.playwright-browsers node --test dist/tests/framework/*.test.js dist/tests/architecture/*.test.js
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run cucumber
scripts.test:api: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.playwright-browsers cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs --profile api
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.playwright-browsers cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs --profile ui
scripts.test:firefox: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.playwright-browsers BROWSER=firefox cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs --profile ui
scripts.test:parallel: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.playwright-browsers PARALLEL=2 cucumber-js --config cucumber.mjs
